The Lynn Vision coaching and operations team

phrases.这不是自动离队：签字前，你仍然可以选择留下。: You have not left your team yet. Until you sign, you can still choose to stay.
phrases.正式加盟后180天不能再次转会。个人资产保留，俱乐部资金和经营权不随你离开。: Joining starts a 180-day transfer cooldown. You keep your personal assets, but the club's funds and management rights stay behind.
phrases.接受，开启下一段生涯: Accept and begin the next chapter
phrases.留下，继续未完成的故事: Stay and finish what we started
phrases.{team} 没有发来合同。你仍在原来的位置上，接下来的训练和比赛还有意义。: {team} does not send a contract. You still have your place, and the practices and matches ahead still matter.
phrases.你关掉合同，把椅子拉回训练桌前。: You close the contract and pull your chair back up to the practice desk.
phrases.队友没有追问，只递来耳机：“那就继续，下一场还等着我们。”: Your teammate doesn't ask any questions, just hands you your headset. 'Then let's keep going. We've got another match.'
phrases.你最后看了一眼 {old_team} 的队标。那是你亲手建立的队伍，却不必成为你: You take one last look at the {old_team} logo. You built this team yourself, but it doesn't have to be the only team you ever play for.
phrases.经营交给了俱乐部，队友仍会继续比赛。你带走的是自己的行李和记忆，不是球队的金库。: The club takes over management, and your teammates keep playing. You leave with your bags and your memories, not the team's bank account.
phrases.有人说你选择了抱团，也有人说更高的舞台值得冒险。: Some say you're taking the easy route by joining stronger players. Others say a bigger stage is worth the risk.
phrases.旧队友看完消息，只问了一句：“你想清楚了吗？”: Your old teammate reads the news and asks just one question. 'Have you thought it through?'
phrases.外界可以替这次转会起名字，但接下来的比赛仍得由你亲手打。: People can call this transfer what they like. You're still the one who has to play the matches.
phrases.队友帮你把外设装进箱子：“去试试吧，我们不怪你。别把想去的地方一直留到以后。”: Your teammate helps pack your equipment. 'Give it a try. We don't blame you. You can't keep putting off the places you want to go.'
phrases.你们约好，下次在服务器里见。: You agree to see each other on the server next time.
phrases.训练室里少了一张椅子，群聊却没有人退出。: There's one fewer chair in the practice room. Nobody has left the group chat.
phrases.那些一起熬过的加时和失败，不会因为一份新合同作废。临走前，你还有一句话想说。: A new contract doesn't erase the overtimes and losses you got through together. Before you leave, there's something you want to say.
phrases.约定下次赛场见: Promise to meet again on the server
phrases.道别不是否定过去: A goodbye doesn't erase the past
phrases.旧队长转发了你的感谢：“一起打过的比赛，不会因为转会清零。”: Your old captain shares your thank-you message. 'A transfer doesn't wipe out the matches we played together.'
phrases.有粉丝祝福，也有人担心新阵容是否适合你。新队教练只说，先把训练赛打好。: Some fans wish you well; others wonder whether the new roster suits you. Your new coach only asks you to focus on scrims for now.
phrases.你把感谢说出口，也学会了不让歉意压住下一步。: You've said your thanks. Now you're learning to move forward without treating that as something to apologize for.
phrases.“那就赛场见。”旧队友在你的动态下留了这句话。: 'See you on the server, then.' Your old teammate leaves the comment under your post.
phrases.媒体把这次告别写成了新旧队伍的约战；有人期待故事继续，也有人提醒你别把狠话说得太: The coverage turns your goodbye into a challenge between the two teams. Some look forward to the meeting; others warn you not to talk too soon.
phrases.新队友拍了拍你的椅背：“先一起练，到了那天我们陪你打。”: Your new teammate pats the back of your chair. 'Let's practice first. When that day comes, we'll be there with you.'
phrases.你只发了一张收好外设的照片。外界猜测是不是闹了矛盾，旧队友却主动回应：“别多想，: You post only a photograph of your packed equipment. People speculate about a falling-out, until your old teammate steps in. 'Don't overthink it. He's never been good at goodbyes.'
phrases.新俱乐部没有催你接受采访。教练把训练时间发来，给你留了一点适应的余地。: The new club doesn't rush you into interviews. The coach sends the practice times and leaves you some room to settle in.
phrases.你不必回答每一种猜测，比赛会慢慢替你说话。: You don't have to answer every guess. There will be matches to play, and time to show what you can do.
phrases.今天是 {name} 的生日。队里等你一句话。: It's {name}'s birthday. Your teammates are waiting to hear from you.
phrases.{event_name} 的机票已经出了。夜里教练发来一条很短的消息：家里有事，: The tickets for {event_name} are booked. That night, the coach sends a short message. Something has happened at home. He won't be coming.
phrases.没人追问细节。第二天集合少了一个会盯签表的人，队里每个人心里都空了一截。: Nobody asks for details. When you meet the next morning, the person who normally keeps an eye on the bracket is missing. Everyone feels the empty space.
phrases.信写得很短。对方不谈胜负，只说这场不必打满全力，事成之后会有一笔不会写进合同的答: The message is short. It doesn't mention winning or losing, only that you don't need to give this match your best. Afterwards, there will be a payment that won't appear in any contract.
phrases.回绝，或者按他说的办。没有第三种体面的说法。: Refuse, or do what they ask. There isn't a respectable third way to describe it.
phrases.目前发现假赛痕迹，正在调查。: Evidence of possible match-fixing has been found. An investigation is underway.
phrases.财务把账本摊在桌上。利息已经连续三个月没有进账。: The accountant opens the books on the table. The interest hasn't been paid for three consecutive months.
phrases.俱乐部可以按合同把你除名，个人名下的钱和饰品一并清掉。: Under the contract, the club can remove you and seize your personal cash and items.
phrases.另一条路没有人愿意写进会议纪要：收拾东西走。成不成，看你自己。: There is another option nobody wants in the minutes: pack up and leave. Whether it works is another matter.
phrases.操纵对局、收受利益的黑幕公之于众，丑闻席卷整个电竞圈。所有曾经的成绩蒙上无法抹去: The evidence becomes public: manipulated matches, money changing hands. The scandal spreads across the scene. Fans leave, the team removes you, and every result you once earned is questioned. You broke the trust that made those matches worth playing. No impressive stat line can undo it. Your career ends with people remembering the fix instead of the player you might have been.
phrases.背负巨额债务，狼狈逃离赛场: Leaving under a mountain of debt
phrases.巨额债务如同枷锁死死缠住了你。为偿还欠款，你早早耗尽竞技状态，成绩一路断崖式下滑: The debt follows you into every match. Trying to pay it off wears you down, and your results collapse. Playing stops feeling like a pursuit of anything; it becomes another way to keep the bills from catching up. Eventually, you announce your retirement and leave in a hurry. The money you chased has taken the place of the game you used to love.

{event}的决赛结束了。{team}输给了{opponent}，最终比分是{final_score}。

你摘下耳机，方才还在盘算后续的攻防，可这场对局结束，再也没有下一回合。对手上前依次握手，意气昂扬，金色的雨落在他们肩头。你静静望着他们走向奖杯高台，眼神里面翻涌着一些说不明的情绪，场馆喧嚣震天，这片欢呼声，却不属于你们。

回到休息室，大家沉默了一会儿。教练把水递给你：‘今天先别急着把所有问题都算在自己头上。等缓过来，我们一起看。’

{player}，亚军不是没有价值，但你也不必马上说服自己已经满足。今晚可以难过，下一次开机时，再决定怎样走回这里。

The final of {event} is over. {team} lost to {opponent}, {final_score}.

You take off your headset. A moment ago you were still planning the next round, but there will be no next round tonight. Your opponents come over to shake hands, gold confetti settling on their shoulders. You watch them walk toward the trophy. The arena is deafening, and none of this cheering belongs to you.

Back in the lounge, nobody speaks for a while. The coach hands you some water. 'Don't put every mistake on yourself tonight. When we've caught our breath, we'll look at it together.'

{player}, second place matters. You do not have to pretend to be satisfied with it already. Be upset tonight. When you turn the game on again, work out how to get back here.

致 {player}：

我们看过你在北美的比赛，也留意了你在不顺的时候如何完成下一场。让我们写下这封邀请的，不只是一个漂亮的数据，而是你面对陌生环境仍然愿意学习和沟通。

Lynn Vision 希望邀请你回国加入阵容，承担适合你的正式位置。我们不承诺每站赛事都有掌声，但愿意给你清晰的训练计划、完整的队友，以及把比赛当作长期工作的机会。

回国不是否定你在外面的一年。恰恰相反，我们希望把那一年的经历带进这支队伍。请认真考虑，你想把下一段生涯交给怎样的团队。

——Lynn Vision 赛训组

Dear {player},

We have watched your matches in North America, including how you approached the next match when things went badly. We are writing because of more than a good statistic. We noticed your willingness to learn and communicate in an unfamiliar environment.

Lynn Vision would like to invite you home to join our active roster in a suitable role. We cannot promise applause at every event. We can offer a clear practice plan, a full team around you, and a chance to treat competition as a long-term profession.

Coming home does not erase your year abroad. We want you to bring that experience into this team. Please think carefully about the people with whom you want to spend the next part of your career.

The Lynn Vision coaching and operations team

The investigation found that you transferred personal assets while club debts remained unpaid and refused to cooperate with the financial settlement.
You are permanently banned from competition. All registered tournament places are void.
This career has ended. To compete again, you must start a new career save.

templates.source: 走进 {event} 的选手通道时，观众席的声音隔着墙传来。你习惯了训练室里键盘的响声，却第一次在这样的舞台上听见 {team} 的名字。把外设接好，确认耳机。灯光再亮，第一回合仍要从眼前的准星开始。
templates.pattern: ^走进\ ([\s\S]+?)\ 的选手通道时，观众席的声音隔着墙传来。你习惯了训练室里键盘的响声，却第一次在这样的舞台上听见\ ([\s\S]+?)\ 的名字。把外设接好，确认耳机。灯光再亮，第一回合仍要从眼前的准星开始。$
templates.replacement: Entering the player corridor at {event}, you hear the crowd through the walls. You know the sound of keyboards in the practice room; hearing {team} called on a stage like this is new. Connect your gear. Check the headset. However bright the lights, the first round still begins with the crosshair in front of you.

templates.source: 比赛页面终于把 {team} 标成了 {event} 冠军。有人已经在算积分，有人还在复盘刚才的残局。没有必要把这一站说成职业生涯的顶峰——它是一次确实完成的进步。关掉语音之前，你们约好了下一次训练。
templates.pattern: ^比赛页面终于把\ ([\s\S]+?)\ 标成了\ ([\s\S]+?)\ 冠军。有人已经在算积分，有人还在复盘刚才的残局。没有必要把这一站说成职业生涯的顶峰——它是一次确实完成的进步。关掉语音之前，你们约好了下一次训练。$
templates.replacement: The match page finally lists {team} as champions of {event}. Someone counts points; someone else reviews the last clutch. You do not have to call this the peak of a career. It is a real step forward. Before leaving voice chat, you agree on the next practice.

templates.source:
{player}：

不必回得太快。有人觉得这场不必打满全力。
事成之后，会有一笔不会出现在任何合同里的答谢。你只需让比分看起来像那么回事。

回这封信就可以。沉默，也会被当成一种答案。

{player},

No need to reply too quickly. Someone thinks you don't have to give this match everything.
Afterwards, there will be a payment that doesn't appear in any contract. All you have to do is make the score look plausible.

Reply to this message. Silence will be taken as an answer, too.

templates.source: 这不是幻觉，也不是热身。镜头对准你们的时候，没有人再把这场比赛当成偶然。{team} 拿下了 {event}。你看了一眼队友——他们也在看你。这一次，是你们站在最上面。
templates.pattern: ^这不是幻觉，也不是热身。镜头对准你们的时候，没有人再把这场比赛当成偶然。([\s\S]+?)\ 拿下了\ ([\s\S]+?)。你看了一眼队友——他们也在看你。这一次，是你们站在最上面。$
templates.replacement: This is no illusion or warmup. As the cameras turn toward you, nobody calls the result an accident. {team} have won {event}. You look at your teammates and find them looking back. This time, you are the ones on top.
templates.prefix: 这不是幻觉，也不是热身。镜头对准你们的时候，没有人再把这场比赛当成偶然。

templates.source: 贴纸已免费更新；个人资金和饰品售价不变。 移除槽位 {removed} 的贴纸；免费编辑，不改变售价。 替换槽位 {replaced} 的贴纸；旧贴纸不会新增为可出售库存。

templates.replacement: Stickers updated for free. Personal funds and item sale prices are unchanged. Removed stickers from slots {removed}; sale prices are unchanged. Replaced stickers in slots {replaced}; old stickers are not added as sellable inventory items.
templates.prefix: 贴纸已免费更新；个人资金和饰品售价不变。 移除槽位

templates.source: 你们赢了。{team} 的名字留在了 {event} 的冠军栏里。有人松了口气，有人已经开始复盘。你暂时没有关掉比分页：通往下一站之前，这一刻值得多看一会儿。
templates.pattern: ^你们赢了。([\s\S]+?)\ 的名字留在了\ ([\s\S]+?)\ 的冠军栏里。有人松了口气，有人已经开始复盘。你暂时没有关掉比分页：通往下一站之前，这一刻值得多看一会儿。$
templates.replacement: You won. {team} now occupy the champions' line at {event}. Some sigh with relief; others have begun the review. You leave the score page open a little longer before moving on.

templates.source: 赛后通道里有人在喊你们的队名。有人已经开始谈下一站，你还想把这一夜多留一会儿。{event} 结束了，冠军是 {team}。奖杯会凉下来，可这次经历不会。
templates.pattern: ^赛后通道里有人在喊你们的队名。有人已经开始谈下一站，你还想把这一夜多留一会儿。([\s\S]+?)\ 结束了，冠军是\ ([\s\S]+?)。奖杯会凉下来，可这次经历不会。$
templates.replacement: Someone calls your team's name in the corridor. Others are already discussing the next event, but you want a little more of tonight. {event} is over. {team} are champions. The trophy will cool in your hands; the memory will not.
templates.prefix: 赛后通道里有人在喊你们的队名。有人已经开始谈下一站，你还想把这一夜多留一会儿。

templates.source: {teammate}在群里看见你的训练状态，半天后回了个‘行，别练太晚’。切蛋糕时仍留了一块，盒子上却没有写什么。你看得出，他理解，也确实有一点失落。
templates.pattern: ^([\s\S]+?)在群里看见你的训练状态，半天后回了个‘行，别练太晚’。切蛋糕时仍留了一块，盒子上却没有写什么。你看得出，他理解，也确实有一点失落。$
templates.replacement: {teammate} sees that you are practising and eventually replies, 'Okay. Don't stay up too late.' He still saves you a slice of cake in an unmarked box. You can tell he understands, and that he is a little disappointed.

templates.source: 更大的舞台还在后面，可今晚的酒是热的。{team} 在 {short} 把比分钉死的时候，你听见自己的呼吸第一次慢下来。先赢这一座。后面的路，明天再说。
templates.pattern: ^更大的舞台还在后面，可今晚的酒是热的。([\s\S]+?)\ 在\ ([\s\S]+?)\ 把比分钉死的时候，你听见自己的呼吸第一次慢下来。先赢这一座。后面的路，明天再说。$
templates.replacement: Bigger stages can wait. Tonight, the drinks are warm. When {team} close the score at {short}, your breathing finally slows. Win this one first. Tomorrow you can talk about the rest of the road.
templates.prefix: 更大的舞台还在后面，可今晚的酒是热的。
